Chemosensory_Tarsal_Organs.description: Equipped with intricate tarsal organs, this arachnid-inspired component enhances the user's chemical sensing abilities, allowing for unparalleled perception of their surroundings and granting the skill of Scent Tracking, enabling them to follow even the faintest trails.

Pedipalp_Olfactory_Sensilla.description: Equipped with elongated, sensitive pedipalps that function as both hands and an enhanced olfactory system, this arachnid component grants the user an unparalleled sense of smell, allowing them to track scents across vast distances and navigate through darkness with ease.

Pheromone_Plume_Detectors.description: Equipped with an intricate array of sensory organs, these detectors allow arachnids to perceive and interpret complex pheromonal signals, enhancing their wisdom and strategic prowess in the intricate web of social hierarchy and communication.

Hygroreceptive_Humidity_Sensors.description: The hygroreceptive humidity sensors, a delicate yet resilient organ nestled within the arachnid's chitinous head, allow it to perceive minute fluctuations in humidity, granting heightened awareness and cunning in the arid desert environment.

Necrotic_Tissue_Chemoreceptors.description: These chemo-receptors, located at the tip of the arachnid's elongated sensory appendages, are sensitive to the chemical signatures of decay, allowing it to navigate the darkest, most forsaken corners of the world with eerie precision and detect even the faintest traces of life or death.

Web_Bound_Taste_Pores.description: Embedded within the arachnid's exoskeleton, these specialized taste pores are intricately linked to the sticky, silken webs that serve as the creature’s sensory extensions, granting it an enhanced perception of its surroundings and an uncanny ability to detect even the faintest vibrations or chemical traces.

CO2_Detection_Hairs.description: These fine, tick-like hairs, sprouting from the arachnid's nose, are attuned to the slightest shifts in carbon dioxide levels, allowing it to sense the breath of prey through the densest of shadows, granting it a heightened awareness and the edge needed for a perfect ambush.

Thermoreceptive_Infrared_Pits.description: Equipped with eerie, chitinous nostrils that emit a faint, pulsating glow, this arachnid adaptation allows its bearer to see through the darkest depths of a cave, rendering the warmth of living creatures visible in a spectrum of vivid shades.

Contact_Chemoreception_Pads.description: Embedded along the underside of the arachnid's leg joints are delicate, sensory pads that detect chemical traces, allowing it to navigate its environment with uncanny precision and enhancing its predatory accuracy.

Water_Quality_Sensilla.description: Equipped with an extraordinary set of water-quality sensilla, this arachnid's eight legs are lined with delicate, hair-like sensors that can detect even the faintest changes in water composition, allowing it to navigate and survive in the most polluted and murky aquatic environments with unparalleled precision.
